description:
[Game reference] Upcoming Rust items: on the staging (test) branch, not in the live game yet. Items on Rust's public staging branch (Facepunch's test build) that the live game doesn't have yet, read from the
test branch's server files and refreshed whenever it updates (2026-11-17). `items`: `shortname`, `name`, `description`,
`category`, `recipe` (`ingredients` with `upcoming` true for ingredients that are new too, `workbench`, `craft_time_s`,
`research_scrap`), `stats` (label/value pairs), `recycle`, `loot` (container, `chance_pct`), `icon_url`, `has_3d`,
`first_seen` (when rust.wiki first saw it on staging). `changed`: live items whose recipe or stats differ on staging
(`changes`: `label`, `old` = live, `new` = staging). `removed`: live items missing from staging. Test-branch content can
change before release or never ship; items leave this list once they reach the live game. `other_changes` (2026-11-17):
what else the test branch changes - `stats` (balance changes in plain words: `area`, `name`, `text`, `changes`),
`settings` (server settings / console commands added, removed or with a new default, with the game's `help`),
`hints` (guesses from the names of code added or removed - not announced features) and `text` (new or changed English
game text). Upcoming Rust items / what is on the staging (test) branch / what comes next update. Test-branch content can change or never ship: say so. other_changes = balance/stat changes, server settings and code-name hints (guesses, not
name: get_upcoming_items
